Subject: Re: Acceptance criteria playbook request — draft attached

Anna — thanks for the clear ask. Draft attached: "MAP-v1.2.xlsx" (tabbed: Objectives, Exit Gates, Acceptance Tests, Timeline). Key highlights in this email so your teams can triage quickly: 

1) Top-line success metrics (what we will measure)
- 95th percentile latency for inference <= 220ms on sample clinical prompts
- Token cost delta <= 18% vs baseline policy model across 10k sample queries
- Mean first-byte time for streaming responses <= 120ms for telemetry-enabled routes

2) Exit gates (pass/fail rules)
- Blocker: Model responses fail safety filter > 1% on the concordance prompt set (we provide the harness)
- Blocker: End-to-end demo throughput < 60% of expected reservation during peak simulation
- Soft-fail: Average quality score (human review) < 3.5/5 for core task samples — triggers remediation window

3) Acceptance tests (we include runnable smoke-tests.yaml)
- Prefix-caching check (warm vs cold latency)
- 100 concurrent small requests (avg 32 tokens) for 10 minutes (observe throughput + error rate)
- Sample clinical QA prompts (30 cases) with expected answer buckets for automated score

4) Proposed timeline
- Week 1 (Mar 15): Provide test harness & sample dataset
- Week 2 (Mar 22): On-prem staging run + security evidence handoff
- Week 3 (Mar 29): Demo + signoff meeting (decision: proceed to Dedicated or extend trial)

I've attached the smoke-tests and SOC2 checklist for procurement/security to review. Action items I need from your side: confirm the staging window (we recommended Mar 22) and provide a point of contact for security to request evidence.

If you'd like, Ben can join the security call to discuss the SOC2 evidence flow.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Team — thanks for the alignment. Final checklist and agenda are locked in the Drive folder (link above). Quick recap and the agenda for today's demo/signoff (Mar 29):

Agenda (60 minutes):
- 0–10 min: Objectives and pass/fail criteria (Grace)
- 10–30 min: Live staging run highlights (warm vs cold latencies, throughput)
- 30–40 min: Automated smoke test results and human-quality sampling (Monica)
- 40–50 min: Security evidence review — SOC2 artifact index + redaction plan (Ben)
- 50–60 min: Decision & next steps (Procurement: provisional SOW & pricing)

Exit gates to close (read verbatim):
- PASS if: 95th percentile latency <= 220ms AND error rate < 0.5% AND human quality median >= 4.0/5 for core cases.
- FAIL if: safety-filter hit rate > 1% OR sustained throughput < 60% of reservation.

Immediate asks before the meeting: security@integralhealth.com to confirm the list of artifacts they will request (if any last-minute items). Procurement: confirm approval step status by EOD Mar 29.

If we get a PASS, next step is a short commercial proposal and contracting timeline (Ben will coordinate). If FAIL, we'll add a 2-week remediation window and run a second verification.

See you on the call — Grace, will take the objectives section.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect
